title: First Fully AI-Generated Movie 'Gods Don't Give Gifts' Secures Theatrical Release
summary:
The singer-songwriter Claire Boucher will make her acting debut in the lead role of the upcoming feature film *Gods Don't Give Gifts*. The production, which also stars YouTuber Mike Majlak as a vagrant, is the first fully AI-generated motion picture to be exhibited in movie theaters.

The creators of the project stated the film represents a shift in the medium similar to the release of *Toy Story* and intend to submit the movie for an Oscar in the Best Animated Feature category. Boucher, who performs under the name Grimes, brings a combined 4 billion views and streams from her music career to the role of a disaffected aristocrat.
